prompt: Detect all instances of: main subject. Response must be a JSON array: [{"label": ..., "bbox": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}, ...]. Coordinates are normalized to [0,1].

runtime: transformers 5.1.0, torch 2.10.0+cpu, torch_npu 2.10.0, CANN 9.0.0, Ascend 910A NPU fp16, attn eager, torch.npu jit_compile=False, greedy, max_new_tokens 64, processor defaults (max_tiles 10, min/max image tokens 64/256)
